card.situation: NASA JSC ORBIT Sources Sought: multi-award IDIQ for flight operations support across four functional areas (Mission/Systems Engineering, Technical Evaluation, Specialized IT/Operations, Advanced R&D) as a follow-on to the expiring MESC-IDIQ vehicles.\nReached the owner because NAICS 541512 matches exactly, the notice is a Total Small Business set-aside for which Sooner Systems qualifies, and Functional Area 3 (Specialized IT and Operations) directly maps to the firm's help desk and cybersecurity core services.
reasons_for: Functional Area 3 help desk and end-user support capability directly maps to the solicitation's mission support services requirement, with two qualifying past-performance records confirming Tier 1–3 service desk delivery [48a0b93b-696cd945-p7-df9f3994].

RMF/ATO documentation, ACAS/Nessus vulnerability management, CMMC Level 2 self-assessed, and 22 Secret-cleared staff provide a strong cybersecurity posture that substantially addresses the NPD 2810.1 IT security compliance requirement [48a0b93b-696cd945-p4-e2f0806d].

The notice is a Sources Sought RFI requiring only a capability statement — no proposal or price — and Sooner Systems can meet the submission deadline with 21.5 days remaining and all required company information on hand [48a0b93b-descript-p0-25e06605].
reasons_against: Sooner Systems has zero spaceflight, ISS, Artemis, or mission operations experience, leaving the core contract scope — enabling flight operations organizations to plan, train, and execute NASA space missions — entirely uncovered [48a0b93b-696cd945-p2-3b37fcad].

14 of 23 requirements are gaps, including all of FA1 (systems/mission engineering), FA2 (technical evaluation), and FA4 (advanced R&D and prototype software), yielding a fit score of only 0.33 and making a competitive IDIQ award highly unlikely [matrix_summary: 6 of 23 requirements met, 3 partial, 14 gap].

Contract value history ($2.1M, $1.65M, $740K) is far below the anticipated IDIQ scale, the firm has no Houston TX presence, and no experience with NASA-specific standards (JSC 63756, FOD SMP, CA-WI-54) required across all functional areas [48a0b93b-696cd945-p5-46e5352e].

drafts.capability_statement:
Sooner Systems LLC — Capability Statement
NAICS 541512 | Total Small Business | SAM.gov Registered | Norman, OK

Sooner Systems LLC is a small business IT services firm with demonstrated federal experience in Tier 1–3 help desk and end-user support, network administration, and cybersecurity. Our core capabilities align directly with ORBIT Functional Area 3 (Specialized IT and Operations).

Help Desk & End-User Support: Sooner Systems delivered Tier 1–3 service desk and desktop support for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Tulsa District (2022–2025, NAICS 541512), supporting a geographically distributed federal workforce under ITIL 4 service management processes including incident, change, and problem management.

Cybersecurity & IT Security Compliance: Under a network administration and cybersecurity contract at the FAA Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (2021–2024, NAICS 541519), Sooner Systems performed RMF/ATO documentation, ACAS/Nessus vulnerability scanning, STIG implementation, SIEM/SOAR operations, and incident response. Our cybersecurity posture supports compliance with federal IT security policy frameworks analogous to NPD 2810.1.

Security Posture: 22 personnel hold active Secret clearances. The firm is CMMC Level 2 self-assessed and maintains established information protection and NDA procedures for all personnel supporting government tasks.

IT Administration: Sooner Systems administers Microsoft 365 and Azure environments and supports ITIL 4 change management for hardware and software components.

We respectfully submit this capability statement in response to the ORBIT Sources Sought and welcome the opportunity to support NASA JSC's Functional Area 3 mission.

Point of Contact: [Name] | jsc-orbit-procurement@mail.nasa.gov response | Sooner Systems LLC, Norman, OK

[48a0b93b-696cd945-p3-58896189]

reader.scope_summary: NASA JSC Flight Operations Directorate is seeking specialized support services across four functional areas: Mission and Systems Engineering Support, Technical Evaluation and Independent Assessment, Specialized IT and Operations, and Advanced Mission R&D, to enable flight operations organizations to plan, train, and execute NASA space missions including ISS, Artemis, and future endeavors. The contract is anticipated to be a multiple-award IDIQ vehicle with Firm-Fixed-Price task orders, structured as a follow-on to the expiring Mission Enabling Support Contract (MESC-IDIQ) vehicles scheduled to expire September 30, 2027. Functional Area 3 (Specialized IT and Operations) is directly relevant to Sooner Systems, encompassing end-user and help desk support services, organization-unique software applications, and security management for a highly mobile and operationally demanding customer community.
reader.incumbent_or_history: This acquisition will establish a follow-on contract vehicle to succeed the Mission Enabling Support Contract MESC-IDIQ contracts, encompassing the legacy and a subset of those requirements including partial scope of MESC-B, which are scheduled to expire on September 30, 2027.
